entities.name: Ohran Ridge
entities.description: A line of mountains on Gulmany in the Terisian Isles of Dominaria; the only part of the Colekgan Mountains clear of glaciers in the Ice Age.

entities.name: Gulmany
entities.description: Island in the Terisian Isles of Dominaria where the Ohran Mountains lie.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Ohran Ridge lies.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: Lived in a cottage on Ohran Ridge with Urza for a period after the Thaw.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Lived at the Ohran Ridge cottage, and returned to it 300 years later while working on the Bloodline project; attacked there by Phyrexian negators.

entities.name: Bloodline project
entities.description: Urza's genetics project in which he hoped to replenish a Femeref genetic line.

entities.name: Phyrexian negators
entities.description: Phyrexian creatures that attacked Urza at the cabin and burned it down.

events.summary: After the Thaw, Xantcha and Urza lived in a cottage on Ohran Ridge.
events.quote: the Ohran Ridge housed the cottage of Xantcha and Urza for a period

events.summary: Some 300 years later Urza returned to the cabin while working on the Bloodline project.
events.quote: Urza returned to the cabin in Ohran Ridge some 300 years later while working on the Bloodline project

events.summary: Phyrexian negators attacked Urza at the cabin, and the cabin burned down in the struggle.
events.quote: Urza was attacked by Phyrexian negators , and the cabin was burned down in the struggle

relations.note: The ridge stretches from the Ohran Mountains on Gulmany.
relations.quote: Ohran Ridge is a line of mountains that stretches from the larger Ohran Mountains on Gulmany

relations.note: Negators attacked Urza at the cabin.
relations.quote: Urza was attacked by Phyrexian negators
